name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
summary: 足球经理模拟，2026 年 9 月 16 日上架，Winning Streak Games GmbH 开发并发行，分类为模拟／体育／策略，主打上手容易、战术有深度并模拟两百多个国家，本版新增可自定义游戏内容的创作模式。商店 AI 披露只点名一件事：本作使用约 12500 张 AI 生成的写实照片，用于阵容界面与球员资料页上的通用男女球员形象，并说明这些图像的取材仅限于专为该目的拍摄的人物照片。本站据此把美术登记为已使用，其余七个领域（游戏运行、代码、音乐、配音、撰写、翻译、宣传素材）因披露没有点名而登记为未说明，不能据此认定未使用。三个第三方页面对披露原文的转录与商店一致，其程度评级不采纳。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（未被截断）、身份（开发与发行均为 Winning Streak Games GmbH，正式版，2026 年 9 月 16 日）与英文讨论区首页：可见 15 个主题、总数 279，即只覆盖首页，可见主题为置顶更新进度与语言请求等，没有 AI 相关讨论。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，5 条结果），登记并读取 3 条来源：gameaicheck.com、gamedb.ai 与 AI Transparency Index 的本作条目页，三者转录或收录的披露原文与商店一致；前两个页面自带的 AI 程度评级与领域标注属第三方自动判断，本站不采纳。剩余两条中一条是商店页（已有官方取证），一条是该站含本作一行的新作清单页，不是本作披露原文。未检索到独立媒体报道，这不能证明披露之外没有 AI 用途，判定只以商店披露原文为准。

english.summary: A football management simulation released on Sep 16, 2026, developed and published by Winning Streak Games GmbH and filed under Simulation, Sports and Strategy, pitched as accessible but tactically deep with more than 200 simulated countries and a new creative mode for tailoring the game. The Steam AI disclosure names a single use, about 12,500 AI generated realistic looking photos of generic male and female players shown on the line up and player profile screens, adding that only photographs of people photographed specifically for this purpose were used. This site records art as used and the other seven areas as not addressed, because the disclosure never names them, which is not proof of non use. The transcriptions on the three aggregator entry pages match the store text and their extent ratings are not adopted, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, the identity (Winning Streak Games GmbH as both developer and publisher, a full release dated Sep 16, 2026) and the first page of the English discussion board, which shows 15 visible topics out of 279 in total, so only the front page was covered and its pinned threads are update status and language requests with no AI topic. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json, all 5 results were dispositioned and three sources were registered and read in full, the gameaicheck.com, gamedb.ai and AI Transparency Index entry pages for this game, whose transcriptions of the disclosure match the store text, while the extent ratings and area labels on two of them are automatic third party judgements this site does not adopt. Of the remaining results one was the Steam store page already covered by the official evidence and one was an aggregator list page carrying this game as one row rather than its disclosure. No independent press report was found, which proves nothing beyond the reviewed disclosure.
